title: ArcBlock says it is under cyberattack and has found no evidence of financial loss so far
date_note: Both pages report ArcBlock's post on 26 November and give no earlier day; the date is the disclosure day.
geo_basis: no location stated in the sources
summary: According to PANews and ChainCatcher, ArcBlock posted on X that it is under a cyberattack and its team is containing and mitigating the threat. PANews quotes the post as saying no evidence of financial loss or asset damage has been found so far. ArcBlock is rebuilding server nodes, rotating credentials and reviewing infrastructure access, and some services may be temporarily affected.
plain: ArcBlock says it is under cyberattack and is working to contain it. It says it has found no evidence of financial loss so far, and some services may be briefly affected.
exec: ArcBlock says some of its services may be temporarily affected while it rebuilds servers and rotates credentials.
action: No action needed; for awareness. ArcBlock says it will update its community as the situation develops.

validation.note: PANews and ChainCatcher both relay one ArcBlock post on X; the post itself was not read (X is a pointer only), so the account is single-source.
